fragments.text: Have mercy on the pillars (the pious) upon which Thou hast founded the footstool (the earth) and the throne; then the Galgal thunders and the throne resounds from Ophan to Ophan, from Hayah to Hayah, from Cherub to Cherub opposite the throne.

en.text: This edition translates only the concluding Rachem Metzuqim stanza. The preceding Hebrew stanzas have no printed English translation.
The printed English follows the main Hebrew reading with Hayyah before Cherub. No English translation of the reversed Hebrew alternative is printed.

title.en: The living creatures by the throne
